name: Kobashiri Yae
source: Yae is a first-year at Bansei High School, and he president of the mahjong club. She is Nara Prefecture's current individual tournament champion. Yae thinks that she is superior to all her prefectural opponents, although this is understandable given her school's unparalleled success. She is always confident, and while she is able to notice when her opponents are more than they seem, she tends to still dismiss them as weaker than she is.
